description.p: Parcha Sky shows the weather as the sky outside right now. The window follows the real sun, moon, clouds, wind, rain and snow for your place, and the forecast sits on frosted glass cards on top of it.

ul.li: Next hour: rain or drizzle starting or ending at your exact spot, from radar
Heads-up: rain windows, gusts, heat, freezing nights and big changes in the next two days, in plain words
Time scrubber: drag through the next 48 hours and the sky plays forward, or watch the next day as a time-lapse
Lenses for temperature, rain, wind and comfort
Best time to be outside, using your own comfort range
Radar map, official alerts in the US and Puerto Rico, and hurricane season tracking
Weather for trips in your calendar, read only on your computer and only if you turn it on
English and Spanish, with playful or plain summaries

description.p: No account and no tracking. Only rough coordinates are sent to the weather services. Weather data from MET Norway, alerts and storms from the US National Weather Service and National Hurricane Center, radar from LibreWXR, map from Natural Earth.
